title: RustLatam 2019 - Without Boats: Zero-Cost Async IO
summary: Without Boats, a Rust language team member, explains the design of Rust's async/await at RustLatam 2019. He covers the history and constraints behind zero-cost, allocation-free async state machines.
why: Recommended during the await syntax debates for explaining the constraints that shaped Rust's async design.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: I really loved this talk by Without Boats
